title: MULTIPLE DWELLINGS
officialText:
314.1 Applicability of the New York State Multiple Dwelling Law (MDL) and Appendix D.
Existing buildings classified in Occupancy Groups I-1, R-1 and R-2, containing 3 dwelling units
or more shall be identified as multiple dwellings, subject to the MDL and Appendix D of this code.
See Sections D101.1 and D102.
314.2 Definitions. Terms unique to existing multiple dwellings as such terms are used in Appendix
D shall have the meaning ascribed to them in Section D201 of this code.
